_about: Looks head-rig.py can turn a real person's photo into (a manifest's heads.<name>.look). Each is one prompt put before LIKENESS and FRONT; the photo goes in as the model's reference picture. Every look is drawn by an image model (the photo leaves the machine for OpenRouter), then made to talk by swapping mouth shapes the same model draws, cut out as patches -- no video model. Names describe the object, never a trademark.
likeness: Make it clearly this particular person from the reference photo: keep their face shape, hairstyle and hair colour, facial hair, skin tone, eyebrows, glasses if they wear them, and the clothes they wear.
front: Front view, looking straight at the viewer, head and shoulders, the mouth closed in a relaxed neutral expression, the eyes open. A single subject on a plain transparent background, no text, no logos, no watermark.

looks.brick: Turn the person in the reference photo into a plastic toy brick minifigure: the classic cylindrical toy head with a simple printed face (dot eyes, printed eyebrows, printed stubble or beard if they have one), their hair as a moulded plastic hair piece, their clothes printed on the minifigure torso, glossy plastic, studio product photo.
looks.blocky: Turn the person in the reference photo into a blocky voxel game character: a perfectly cubic head and body made of big square pixels, a flat pixel-art face in their skin tone with pixel eyes, pixel hair and pixel beard matching theirs, their clothes as pixel textures.
looks.newspaper: Redraw the person in the reference photo as a newspaper stipple-and-hatch portrait (a 'hedcut'): black ink dots and fine lines on white, like the portraits printed in business newspapers.
looks.caricature: Draw the person in the reference photo as a friendly caricature for a bobble-head doll: a big head on a small body, gently exaggerated features, clean colourful illustration.
looks.clay: Turn the person in the reference photo into a chunky handmade plasticine puppet for a stop-motion film: simplified rounded features, a slightly oversized head, visible thumbprints and seams in the clay, obviously a puppet, never lifelike.
looks.crayon: Redraw the person in the reference photo as a hand-drawn crayon illustration: wobbly dark ink outlines, flat crayon fills with visible waxy texture, simple friendly shapes, like a children's picture book, on no background.
looks.papercut: Recreate the person in the reference photo as a layered paper cut-out collage: flat shapes cut from coloured construction paper with visible scissor edges, paper grain and small shadows between the layers.
looks.woodcut: Redraw the person in the reference photo as a bold woodcut print: black carved lines and gouges on off-white paper with one muted red accent, the rough texture of a relief print.
looks.watercolour: Paint the person in the reference photo as a loose watercolour portrait: soft washes that bleed at the edges, a few light pencil lines, paper texture showing through.
looks.popart: Redraw the person in the reference photo as a pop-art print: thick black outlines, flat bold primary colours and Ben-Day halftone dots in the shading, like a 1960s screen print.
looks.courtroom: Draw the person in the reference photo as a courtroom sketch: quick expressive coloured-pencil and pastel strokes on cream paper, loose hatching, unfinished edges.
looks.chalk: Draw the person in the reference photo in coloured chalk on a small square of dark green chalkboard: dusty chalk strokes, smudges, the board filling the square behind them.
looks.sticker: Turn the person in the reference photo into a round-headed flat vector avatar sticker: a big circular head, simple flat features, their hairstyle, facial hair and clothes simplified into clean flat colour shapes, a thick white sticker outline.
looks.felt: Turn the person in the reference photo into a felt hand puppet: fuzzy fleece and felt fabric, a wide puppet mouth, button-like eyes, yarn or fleece hair in their hairstyle and colour, their clothes sewn in felt.
looks.knit: Turn the person in the reference photo into a knitted wool doll: visible knit stitches, yarn hair in their hairstyle and colour, embroidered eyes and features, their clothes knitted.
looks.peg: Turn the person in the reference photo into a painted wooden peg doll: a smooth turned-wood head and body, simple hand-painted face, painted hair and clothes, visible wood grain, a classic toy-shop wooden figure.
looks.sock: Turn the person in the reference photo into a sock puppet: a knitted sock in their skin tone with a big hinged mouth, button eyes, yarn hair and beard matching theirs, a little felt collar in the colour of their clothes.

variants.small: the mouth slightly open, as if in the middle of saying 'eh', the teeth just showing
variants.open: the mouth open, as if in the middle of saying 'ah'
variants.round: the lips rounded and pushed forward, as if in the middle of saying 'oo'
variants.blink: the eyes closed, as in the middle of a blink, the mouth closed as it is now

edit: This exact picture, identical in every way -- the same character, pose, framing, size, position, lighting, colours and transparent background -- with one change only: {change}, in the picture's own style. Nothing else moves or changes.
